implementation: Original finite field arithmetic, after extracting the determinant into a shared header

build.runtime: One sequential process; --parallel was used for compilation only

source.note: The base commit alone does not identify the extracted header and other uncommitted changes used for these runs.

recorded_user_procedure.substitutions: Matrix sizes 64, 128, and 256; run indices 1, 2, and 3. Build once for each size, then collect three separate process executions.

measurement.source_logs: Repository-root original-<matrix_size>-run<run>.log files, named in runs.csv.
measurement.wall_seconds: GNU Time elapsed wall-clock seconds, recorded to hundredths.
measurement.app_total_seconds: Application steady-clock total; a different timing boundary from GNU Time wall time.
measurement.phase_seconds: Application-reported generation, product, and individual determinant times.
measurement.det_sum_seconds: Sum of the three determinant phase times within one run.
measurement.rss_units: KiB, from GNU Time Maximum resident set size (kbytes) on Linux.
measurement.summary: Median of each timing column independently; maximum peak RSS across the three runs. median_det_sum_seconds is the median of per-run sums, not the sum of phase medians.
measurement.limits: Three measured sizes and three runs each; no function-level profiler data has been collected.
